results.title: The chord estimate in a formal neighbourhood
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: Let $K$ be a field with a discrete valuation $v$, let $A\in K$ with $v(A)\ge0$, and let $k\ge1$. For affine points $P_1,P_2\in W_k(K)$ of $y^2=x^3+Ax$ with $P_1+P_2$ affine, write $z=-x/y$ and $\omega=-1/y$. Then $P_1+P_2$ has $v(z(P_1+P_2))\ge k$ and $v(\omega(P_1+P_2))\ge3k$, and there is a line $\omega=\lambda z+\nu$ in the $(z,\omega)$-plane passing through $P_1$ and $P_2$ with $v(\lambda)\ge2k$, $v(\nu)\ge3k$…

results.title: The generator lies in the dyadic formal group
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: Let $v_s$ be the valuation of $K_0$ at the prime $(s)$, normalized by $v_s(s)=1$ (so $v_s(2)=2$). Then Hence, for the formal neighbourhood of $E$ over $K_0$ at the valuation $v_s$, $P_0\in E_3\subset E_1$, and every multiple $[n]P_0$ ($n\in\mathbb Z$) lies in $E_1$ with $v_s(z([n]P_0))\ge3$. The filtration depends only on the valuations of the coordinates, so the same holds in the completion $K_{(s)}$.
